# Released Kiroku 0.7.1.0 migration payloads

Frozen from the Hackage `kiroku-store-migrations-0.7.1.0.tar.gz` archive,
owned by mori://shinzui/kiroku/packages/kiroku-store-migrations. All fifteen
SQL files match the retained prefix at release commit
`22d103e4f424caab06c6a2b76ad92b408c262bc0`. Tests freeze their SHA-256s and
require the current composed plan to verify the installed checksums before
applying 0016 and 0017. Never regenerate these from current SQL.
